units.source_text: 我做出一副略帶傷感的微笑表情應答道：「我也正是這麼想的。」

en.t: I answered with a faintly sorrowful smile, saying, "That is exactly what I think too."

units.source_text: 總之，惹怒她很可怕，必須得想出一個辦法討好她。

en.t: In any case, it was frightening to make her angry, so I had to think of some way to please her.

units.source_text: 出於這種想法，我把這位既醜陋又討厭的女人伺候得越來越好，

en.t: With that thought in mind, I served this ugly and hateful woman more and more attentively,

units.source_text: 讓她買東西給我（她買的東西其實品位極差，

en.t: and had her buy things for me, although the things she bought were in fact in extremely poor taste,

units.source_text: 我大多立刻轉手送給了雞肉烤串店的老闆），

en.t: and I usually passed them on at once to the owner of the grilled chicken skewer shop,

units.source_text: 並裝出眉歡眼笑的樣子，開玩笑逗她開心。

en.t: and put on a delighted expression, joking to make her laugh.
